items.title: ZDI-CAN-27900: Autodesk
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Masahiro Iida with LAC Co., Ltd. https://www.lac.co.jp/' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-09-11, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-01-09 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
